name: Project Sekai: Colorful Stage! feat. Hatsune Miku
original_name: プロジェクトセカイ カラフルステージ！ feat. 初音ミク
source:
A mysterious song named "Untitled" with no melody or lyrics is passed around among the youth in Shibuya, Tokyo.

This song unlocks access to "SEKAI", a mysterious place that allows everyone to discover their true emotions and their own song.

[From the [url=https://www.colorfulstage.com/]official website[/url]]
